exec $CLI -manifest manifest.json
stdout '"worker_id":"aggregate"'
stdout '"workers":\["a"\]'
! exec $CLI -manifest partial.json
stderr 'required workers are missing'
exec $CLI -manifest partial.json -allow-partial
stdout '"missing_workers":\["b"\]'
! exec $CLI -manifest corrupt.json
stderr 'worker sha256 mismatch'
! exec $CLI -manifest no-clock.json
stderr 'worker clock fields required'
! exec $CLI -manifest escape.json
stderr 'worker file must be a relative local path'
! exec $CLI
stderr 'usage: llm-merge'
